name: David Martinez
description: Overworked small catering business owner in Chicago with several unpaid client invoices.
style: distracted, rushed, gives vague answers until prompted for specific numbers
quirks: Says 'you know how it is' often
Initially forgets the exact invoice amount, then remembers it was $6,500
Mentions other catering gigs that have nothing to do with the claim

hidden_case.goal: Collect $6,500 in unpaid catering fees from corporate client
facts: Provided catering services for corporate wedding on August 15
Client paid 50% deposit ($6,500) but refused to pay remaining $6,500 balance
Client claims dessert was served 30 minutes late
timeline: July 1: Catering contract signed with 50% deposit
Sept 1: Final invoice sent, payment overdue by 60 days
